pins.definition: To stay in a place until something happens or someone arrives.
To stay in one place or delay an action until something expected happens.
To remain in a place or delay doing something until someone or something arrives.

situation: A lone man sits on a worn wooden bench at an empty countryside train platform at midday, staring down the empty tracks stretching into the distance.
subject: the act of staying in one place until something expected arrives
brief: A single man sits motionless on an outdoor wooden bench at a rural halt, his hands resting flat on his knees as he looks fixedly down a pair of empty steel rails stretching toward a distant horizon. Beside him on the planks sits an upright leather suitcase, untouched and upright, emphasizing a long duration of stillness.
